messages:
maria: Heads up — canary perf job flagged a 30-45% tail latency increase on short-chat traffic after yesterday's merge (merge 9f3b2d).
ashok: which merge touched what? I saw a tiny prefetch/routing tweak in the scheduler PR, could be that.
ci-bot: CI perf-regression-detect: canary/job/serve-latency failed threshold check (+35% p99) for commit 9f3b2d.
tess: pinging infra: did anything change in kernel-selection heuristics or batch thresholds in that PR?
maria: PR changed: adaptive prefetch window from 16->24 and added 'route_by_seq' gating for low-seq requests. Diff: ```diff -- a/runtime/scheduler.cc + prefetch_window = 24; + if (seq_len < 8) route_to_fastpath = true; ```
samir: that route gating could hurt batching decisions if prefetch pulls more small requests onto fast path and prevents aggregation.
ashok: ok doing a quick bisect on canary branch, will try reverting that gating locally and rerun the perf job.
ashok: (after 12m) reverted gating + prefetch window back to 16 in a branch and re-ran the perf-runner — p99 back to baseline locally.
maria: good sign. Can you push a cherry-pick/revert PR so we can test in CI? We should also run profiler snapshots comparing KV cache hit rates.
ashok: created PR 392-revert-prefetch-routing -> cherry-pick of upstream commit 9f3b2d revert. CI triggered: https://ci/392
ci-bot: build #112 triggered for PR 392-revert-prefetch-routing. perf-suite: running serve-latency canary.
qa-bot: adding a profiling job: collect kv_cache.metrics, batch_size.hist, kernel_choice.count, seqlen.dist for the same workload window.
ashok: note: we also saw increase in KV cache evictions in the first ten minutes on canary — likely due to more small-req churn.
tess: we should backport a small guard into release-1.12: clamp prefetch_window by traffic-segment, e.g., prefetch_window = min(config, 20) for short-chat customers. Less risky than full revert.
maria: plan: 1) merge revert PR after CI perf passes, 2) open release-1.12 backport with clamp patch, 3) monitor kv hit-rate and p99 for 1h post-deploy, 4) if stable, unblock rollout. Anyone object?
samir: +1. Also recommend we add a quick unit test for route_by_seq gating interplay with batcher coalescing to prevent regressions.
ashok: CI perf passed on the revert PR: perf-suite p99 delta +1% (within noise). merging now.
deploy-bot: Deployed canary build b-2025012345-revert to canary cluster. Notifying routing group.
qa-bot: profiler snapshots uploaded: kv_hit_rate baseline: 0.87, after faulty merge: 0.62, after revert: 0.86. Batch size median dropped from 4->2 during regression and recovered to 4 after revert.
maria: thanks. I'll prepare the backport patch to release-1.12 with the clamp and the unit test. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform for verification.
tess: when you open the backport PR, add `perf/regression=blocking` label and request samir for test review.
maria: backport PR 401 created with clamp + test. CI running. cc @ashok for cross-check.
ci-bot: perf-suite for PR 401 running. Note: runs will include extended 30m steady-state to catch KV warmup regressions.
maria: awesome. We should keep the canary rollout paused until PR 401 is merged into release branch and smoke-tested.
ashok: noted. I'll watch the perf dashboards and set an automated alert for kv_eviction_rate spike > 0.05.
samir: postmortem action items: add test, add perf gate for prefetch_window changes, and document expected seqlen distribution assumptions in scheduler doc.
maria: closing loop: revert merged and deployed to canary, backport PR opened. Will post updates after release branch verification. :thumbsup:
